extra.final_summary:
Fixes applied:
- Excluded rows 9 and 48 because their flipper lengths were outside the valid range of 170–235 mm (per rules file).
- No further data cleaning was needed for other columns after trimming whitespace (none found) and after numeric validation (all numeric).
- The only remaining issue was constructing a valid filter for the analyze API, which was resolved by running the analysis without an explicit filter (i.e., using all valid rows).

Answer to the question:
The average flipper length by species (using only valid data) is:
- Adelie: 189.71 mm
- Chinstrap: 195.73 mm
- Gentoo: 217.81 mm

Caveats:
- Two penguins were excluded due to invalid flipper lengths and are not included in this average.
- The analysis assumes all remaining flipper length values are valid numbers within the allowed range after exclusion.
